tools.name: order_service
tools.description: Workflow capabilities by slug. @1.2.6 (default): with MCP_X402_WALLET_KEY auto-settles USDC (x402 v2, ExactEvmScheme, eip155:8453). Without wallet key, returns 402 with actionable setup instructions. Zero-argument auto-pay covers every $0.01–$0.05 capability except transcribe-extract/doc-extract, which require caller input.

tools.name: help_me
tools.description: Canonical distress meta-tool (session-less x402, $0.01). Describe any failure state → named distress_class + the deep door to call next + stop/preserve/continue.

tools.name: schema_repair
tools.description: Deep door (session-less x402, $0.03): a tool/MCP call keeps failing argument/schema validation → repair_class + fix recipe + stop/preserve/continue verdict.

tools.name: context_pressure
tools.description: Deep door (session-less x402, $0.03, alias token-pressure): out of context/token budget → deterministic band (continue/compact/reconstruct) from your remaining figure.

tools.name: payment_confirmation_check
tools.description: Deep door (session-less x402, $0.01): attempted a settlement, unsure it confirmed → verdict confirmed/pending/failed/already_fulfilled so you do not double-pay.

packages.note: Recommended autopay path. order_service auto-pays 402 (x402 v2, ExactEvmScheme, network eip155:8453) when MCP_X402_WALLET_KEY set on MCP server process. Autopay default covers every zero-argument $0.01–$0.05 slug; transcribe-extract/doc-extract are routable but excluded from the zero-arg default (need a caller-supplied input — call /api/bar/x402/transcribe and /api/bar/x402/extract directly, or opt in via MCP_X402_ALLOW_SLUGS). 1.1.x is broken — it registered x402 v1 clients that fail production v2 402s.
Legacy free-reads fallback only; paid services return 402 — pay via REST x402 or upgrade to 1.2.6 for compatibility auto-pay
